answer: Each submission hangs on the falcon of a task receipt, and the pigment is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Reaching the onyx of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
